zh-CN.title: 连续刷新也不会掉登录
items: 跨页面协调登录凭证刷新，避免重复轮换
旧请求不会再清除刚更新的新会话
网络波动不再被误判为登录失效

en.title: Stay signed in through rapid refreshes
items: Session refresh is coordinated across page reloads
Stale requests can no longer erase a newer session
Network interruptions are no longer treated as an expired login
